title: Puppy Approved! He was so happy! 5+
text: Received my Pawstruck Chew box.... My Puppy loved it.... All of his chew bones and treats lasted a long time.... He was very excited to get his surprise box.... It gave him lots of joy and comfort for his chew time. Some of his chew bones were Smokey scented. Very happy! Puppy Approved ☺️
label: positive
